scope: Historical natural astronomical OH emission only; no physical transmitter profiling, tracking, classifier or automatic suppression.
archive_policy: Try original archive HTTP URL as published and HTTPS if different; official Berkeley host only, no TLS verification disable. HTTP header metadata provisional, not authenticated raw signal. Do not synthesize mirror URLs.

frame.convention: radio LSRK; verify frame flags, otherwise conditional topocentric hypothesis. Use scan midpoint and report variation at endpoints. No assumption that metadata alone establishes reference frame.

measure.description: Replay frozen ON/OFF observation only; test within predeclared published LSR intervals plus margin, using frequency-axis transformation, not a posteriori shift. Descriptive statistics only. Round-trip transform check; no independent astronomy confirmation until extra epochs qualified.
